notes: NEW subject pack: Music Basics — rhythm and meter, scales and keys, intervals, chords and triads, dynamics and tempo, melody and harmony, musical form, and timbre and texture, with which-idea, beat-duration-from-tempo, and note-value practice, never your assignment.

Detector V30 was trained and measured this run but HELD, not shipped: on the permanent frozen probe it caught 12 of 18 humanized texts, below the shipped V20’s 13, so V20 stays live until a round genuinely beats it. The vocabulary diagnosis from this round found the detector top AI signals are informal-voice markers themselves (actually, just, honestly, my, me), which real informal human writing shares — the next lever must break that confounding, not add more data. The round held the second probe at 12 of 12 and the false-flag rate at 4.46% (below V20’s 4.71%), with GPT-5 detection at 92.2% and neural-paraphrase detection at 54.4%.
Nothing else changed: the detector (V20), the review queue, tutor rules, and Ollama connection are untouched, and no new server calls were added.
